title: MVP end-to-end perception-guidance loop
purpose: Integrate the closed loop: spoken request → live camera → target detection → relative position → spoken guidance, repeated until target reached.
architecturalScope: Platform integration. Orchestrates ProductRequest, VisualSearch, Guidance and Safety; owns nothing domain-specific of its own.
domainContext: GuidanceSession, TargetProduct, TargetTrack, Observation, Confidence, NavigationInstruction.

milestones.title: Integration slice with fakes
milestones.description: Loop runs end-to-end with dummy adapters and is deterministic.

milestones.title: Real adapters wired
milestones.description: Local STT + VLM + TTS drive a real device.

milestones.title: Field acceptance
milestones.description: A test user completes the MVP acceptance goal without visual interaction.

tasks.title: Wire the loop with dummy adapters
acceptanceCriteria: Deterministic end-to-end test from utterance to instruction.

tasks.title: Wire real local adapters
acceptanceCriteria: Loop runs on a device with local STT, VLM and TTS.
evidence: browser adapters wired in app/src/ui/main.ts; real-device run pending

tasks.title: Conduct acceptance test with a user
acceptanceCriteria: All 8 acceptance steps pass without visual UI interaction.

A test user can: open app, say a product, aim the camera, hear live search guidance, have the product detected, receive left/right/up/down/forward guidance, approach it, and hear a target-reached message.
No map, SLAM, routing, retailer API or inventory is required.
All AGENTS.md DoD items (a11y, safety, privacy) are satisfied for this loop.

risks.mitigation: MVP development rule: prioritise the closed loop until acceptance is met.

risks.description: End-to-end latency too high for usable guidance.
risks.mitigation: Configurable sampling, small models, deduplicated speech.

safetyImplications: Integration must keep the Safety Supervisor in the path; no bypass for performance.
accessibilityImplications: Acceptance explicitly requires operation without visual UI interaction.
privacyImplications: The loop runs offline by default; cloud vision is optional and explicit.
verificationRequirements: Field test against the 8 acceptance steps.

decisionLog.decision: MVP prioritises the closed perception-guidance loop over store maps, SLAM and routing.
decisionLog.rationale: See docs/15-mvp-priority.md; full navigation is deferred to later extensions.
